name: 多多
evolution: 多多 → 多啦多 Lv.16 → 古啦多 Lv.36
description: 头部帽子一样的组织触感舒适，冰凉弹软。受到惊吓的话，会从头部喷射出大量毒液，之后迅速缩起陷入昏厥状态。
descriptionEn: The cap-like tissue on its head feels comfortable, cool and bouncy. When startled, it sprays large amounts of venom from its head, then quickly curls up and falls into a faint.

skills.name: 溃烂触碰
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 不可接触
skills.description: 减伤50%，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能减伤+10%，应对攻击。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 50%; for each Poison stack the enemy has, this skill's damage reduction +10%; in response to attacks.

skills.name: 以毒攻毒
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，自己获得魔攻+30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each Poison stack the enemy has, gains Magic Attack +30%.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, gains Defense +70%; in response to status: skill power doubled and Defense additionally +70%.
